source.content: Two abstraction levels in LOOP: (1) Sound/element layer — pads 1–6 and KEYBOARD hold playable samples/synth hits (PLAY/SOUND); step lanes map to pad sounds. (2) Song layer — 6 loop tracks with PCM clips on the timeline (offset, mute/solo, length); project.seq patterns A–D are song-level rhythmic programs; track.seq is per-track step data stored on each loop track. UI: loop-tracks = song arrangement; PATTERN SEQ (loop options A or track menu) = 6-lane Screen 24; TRACK STEP SEQ (track menu) = single-lane Screen 24 for one track. Timeline restructure moved SEQ off soft key B (now MUTE); both seq modes restored via menu/options.
source.title: CASSIO abstraction: sounds → song

source.content: CASSIO agents and Grapher curation operate under agile SDLC precedence. Lifecycle stages (ideation→designing→planning→developing→launching→maintaining) define where work sits, not just labels. Truth precedence when building: (1) verified current implementation, (2) canonical_spec scoped to intent, (3) proposed/designing as next increment, (4) historical/superseded as context only. Work in small developing increments; verify (smoke/tests) before marking current; supersede explicitly; graph deviations from manual rather than silent drift. Bulk v2 status fields are not authoritative until curated with evidence and explanations.
source.title: Operating precedence: Agile SDLC
